bias.en: Bearish, improving · MACD and SAR turned up
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · MACD 与 SAR 转多

read.en: MP Materials rose 0.5% on Oct 28 to $41.06, trading between $39.69 and $41.36. It is above the falling 5-day ($39.25) and 10-day ($39.55) averages and below the falling 30-day ($44.41), 100-day ($50.10) and 200-day ($55.47). MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 28, still below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($37.11), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月28日上涨 0.5%，收于 $41.06，盘中区间 $39.69–41.36。股价位于下行的 5 日（$39.25）和 10 日均线（$39.55）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$44.41）、100 日（$50.10）和 200 日均线（$55.47）。MACD 于 10月28日上穿信号线，仍在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$37.11），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The close held the 5 and 10-day, but the $41.36 high stayed under $41.8. Resistance is $41.4–41.8 (Oct 28 high), then $42.5 (Oct 16 high) and $44.4–44.5 (30-day, Oct 1 low). Support is $39.3–39.7 (5 and 10-day, Oct 28 low), then $38 (Oct 27 low) and $37.1 (52-week low, SAR). A close above $41.8 would target $42.5–44.5; below $39.3, $38.
